description: This file defines the HarRecorder class responsible for recording HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser sessions, including managing ZIP archives of content, and serializing HAR logs.

classes.name: HarRecorder
classes.description: A class that records HAR entries, manages ZIP content, and exports HAR logs.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a HAR entry.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Handles the completion of a HAR entry.

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Handles the content blob associated with a HAR entry.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes recorded data, finalizes the HAR log, and writes to disk or ZIP.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the HAR artifact after flushing.
